# rules-stocktake

> A Claude Code skill (MIT) that audits always-loaded behavioral rules (`~/.claude/rules/`) for quality. The sibling of skill-stocktake with the cost model inverted: a rule's cost is per-session residency, not trigger pollution. Mechanical integrity checks (unresolved ``skill: `name` `` pointers, broken relative links between rule files, missing origin headers, missing `rationale:` / `review-when:` comments, rules README table drift) run as throwaway grep; a six-question binary screen plus refutation pressure-test feeds holistic Keep / Improve / Update / Merge / Demote-to-skill / Dissolve / Retire verdicts.

## Core documentation

- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt): self-contained Q&A reference for AI agents (Project Facts, question-form H2 sections)
- [README.md](README.md): human-facing narrative (inverted cost model, modes, verdict criteria) — [README.ja.md](README.ja.md) is the Japanese version
- [SKILL.md](skills/rules-stocktake/SKILL.md): full skill specification — modes, four-phase flow, six-question screen, mandatory-surface rule, ledger format
- Status: active, synced one way from the author's Claude Code harness by `scripts/sync-from-local.sh`; also shipped in the [akc-cycle](https://github.com/shimo4228/akc-cycle) plugin as `/akc-cycle:rules-stocktake`, so this repository can trail the plugin between syncs

## Architecture

- 7 verdicts: **Keep** (earns residency), **Improve** (tighten — usually shorten), **Update** (outdated tech reference), **Merge into X** (overlap with another rule), **Demote to skill** (valuable but not worth per-session residency — the inverse of rules-distill), **Dissolve** (absorbed by the substrate or the conversation — retirement by success, recorded in an ADR), **Retire** (defect-based removal)
- No usage axis: rules load unconditionally, so the audit replaces usage with two static signals — residency density (is each line worth reading every session?) and substrate absorption (does the harness already do this natively?)
- Mandatory-surface rule: a No on the absorption question MUST surface the rule as a Dissolve candidate — an absorbed rule actively overrides evolving harness defaults, unlike an unused skill that sleeps harmlessly
- Mechanical integrity checks always run over the full set, even in changed mode — retiring a skill silently breaks a ``skill: `name` `` pointer in an unmodified rule, invisible to mtimes
- Lean verdict ledger: `results.json` (`{evaluated_at, total_lines, rules:{stem:{path,lines,verdict,reason,mtime}}}`), keys directory-qualified (`common/planning`)
- 4 phases: Inventory + integrity checks → Evaluation (binary screen + pressure-test) → Summary (Rule | Lines | Verdict | Reason + total delta) → Consolidation (user-gated one candidate at a time with `[y/n/skip]`, never in bulk; Improve/Update/Merge edits applied in-session, Demote hands off to a skill named `skill-creator`, Dissolve offers an ADR via `adr-writer`)

## Standard reference

- [Agent Skill specification](https://agentskills.io/specification): the Claude Code skill format used by this repo

## Sibling skills

- [skill-stocktake](https://github.com/shimo4228/skill-stocktake): the same audit for skills — trigger-pollution cost model, usage measurement hook
- [skill-health](https://github.com/shimo4228/skill-health): structural-debt scan for skill libraries (Curate's code layer)
- [agent-stocktake](https://github.com/shimo4228/agent-stocktake): the same audit for subagent definitions (`~/.claude/agents/`)
- [rules-distill](https://github.com/shimo4228/rules-distill): promotes cross-cutting skill patterns INTO rules — rules-stocktake audits what accumulated and demotes back what stopped earning residency
- [skill-comply](https://github.com/shimo4228/skill-comply): measures whether rules are actually followed (dynamic); rules-stocktake stays static and never issues compliance verdicts without it
- [akc-cycle](https://github.com/shimo4228/akc-cycle): installs the whole cycle (this skill included) as one Claude Code plugin, plus an optional always-loaded rules file whose Scaffold Dissolution section is the source of the Dissolve criteria
- [shimo4228](https://github.com/shimo4228/shimo4228): the author's hub — AKC next to the other practice lines and their concept DOIs
